name: workflow
description: Lean, risk-budgeted workflows for Codex with one primary path, focused context, selective subagents, single-pass verification, and explicit completion gates.

interface.shortDescription: One-path engineering workflow with bounded agents and verification
interface.longDescription: A lean, risk-budgeted workflow plugin for Codex. It selects one primary path per task, keeps intent and context discovery local, reserves durable .workflow artifacts for work that needs them, supports production UI contracts and quick chat-only audits, dispatches agents only for concrete benefit, and stops after one profile-appropriate verification/review path passes.
defaultPrompt: Use $audit-flow for a quick project audit
Use $ui-contract for this production frontend change
Use $executing-plans on the active workflow plan
Use $finalizing-plan for one bounded completion pass
